name: Channel Test — middle C on each amp in turn
description: MPL test case: middle C (C++) on each amp's channel in turn — Voice m11, Drums m10, Bass m13, Guitar m14, Piano m15, Other m16 — a beat apart. The 🔊 channel test button plays the same notes and also speaks each amp's name through its own output.
